summary: Phase 8 (FAQ + atomic ticket counter + SUPPORT_PASSWORD + Messages popup) verified. Backend 11/11 PASS via pytest. Frontend: support-faq accordion (PASS), admin-faq-forbidden for non-admin (PASS), admin-faq-page for stealth (PASS), Messages popup portal opens with Edit/Delete/Cancel + backdrop on tap of own bubble (PASS, screenshot-verified), dm-status pill 'Delivered' visible before popup (PASS).

integration_issues.issue: On /admin/faq, programmatic click of [data-testid='admin-faq-toggle-create'] did not reliably reveal [data-testid='admin-faq-create-panel'] on the second attempt within the same session — appears to be playwright timing / React state hand-off rather than a real bug (the panel renders correctly on first navigation and the underlying admin POST /api/admin/faq works perfectly in backend tests). Suggest verifying manually that the toggle reliably opens the panel.

Popup renders correctly (screenshot confirms Edit/Delete/Cancel buttons visible inside MESSAGE ACTIONS panel via portal) but playwright reported is_visible=False on the action buttons immediately after popup mount — likely opacity/transform transition (initial opacity:0 -> opacity:1). The buttons are present in DOM (locator resolves to <button data-testid='dm-action-cancel-…'>). Add a small delay or final opacity:1 before interaction in real users; or remove the enter-animation if it blocks instant taps.

verified_against_spec.Frontend Messages popup opens via portal: PASS (screenshot-verified — MESSAGE ACTIONS popover shown right of bubble)

action_items: (LOW) Verify admin-faq-toggle-create reliably opens the create panel — second toggle within the same SPA session appeared to not re-open the panel during automation. Manual check in browser recommended.

critical_code_review_comments: routers/faq.py is clean — uses async motor, excludes _id, has admin gate, and validates lengths via pydantic Field max_length. No issues.
routers/tickets._next_ticket_number now correctly uses db.counters with $inc + ReturnDocument.AFTER and seed-from-existing-max migration on first call — race-free.
core/seed.seed_support_account now honours SUPPORT_PASSWORD env (per spec); default Password1$ login verified working.
MessageActionMenu portal renders all required testids (dm-actions-{id}, -desktop, -backdrop, dm-action-edit/delete/cancel-{id}) per spec.

rca of the issue: No real bugs. Two automation-only quirks: (a) admin-faq create-panel toggle didn't open on a repeated attempt within the same SPA session — likely React state persistence across navigations. (b) MessageActionMenu portal uses an opacity-enter animation that makes playwright treat the freshly-mounted buttons as not visible for ~100-200ms; real users tap after the animation completes so this is cosmetic.
